sentences.en: Everyone strives for efficiency but few seem to attain it.
sentences.zh: 每个人都力求提高效率，但似乎很少有人能达到。

sentences.en: The authorities are striving in vain to stabilize the currency.
sentences.zh: 当局徒劳地努力稳定货币。

sentences.en: We strive to improve our products, services, content, and advertising.
sentences.zh: 我们致力于改进我们的产品、服务、内容和广告。

senses.zh: 努力奋斗，力求,斗争，力争
